advancedFooter: Overrides replace a preset setting for you. Loosening one needs your passkey and takes effect after 24 hours.
capsFooter: Lowering a limit applies immediately. Raising a limit needs your passkey, then applies immediately too.
customiseHint: Override individual settings instead of following the preset.

mandates.newBody: Pick a verified recipient and set limits. Creating a mandate needs your passkey and takes effect after 24 hours.
mandates.noVerifiedPayees: Add and verify a recipient first.

mandates.title: Mandates

paymentsFooter: Money mode and payment approval decide how payments are made.

title: Settings

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.footer: If you lose every device with your passkey, a backup code lets you set up a new passkey. Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe, like a password manager or on paper.
backupCodes.regenerate: Create new codes (old ones stop working)
backupCodes.shownOnce: Save these now. They will not be shown again.
backupCodes.savedConfirm: I saved these codes somewhere safe
backupCodes.requiredBody: Backup codes are required. If you lose the device with your passkey, a code is the only way back into your account. Create them now and keep them safe.

data.importFooter: Bank statements as PDF, CSV or Excel (several banks at once), or JSON from Kassa or another money app. Account and card numbers are never kept, and Kassa shows you what it will add before anything changes.
